exposure.needed: whether the configured Cilium cluster name violates the 32-char lowercase alphanumeric/'-' rule

consequence.statement: A cluster name not meeting the rules can currently be tolerated by setting upgradeCompatibility to v1.15 or earlier, but validation will be strictly enforced starting from Cilium v1.17.
consequence.remediation: Rename the cluster to at most 32 lowercase alphanumeric characters or '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric character.

assertion.statement: Cilium cluster name is now validated (max 32 lowercase alphanumerics or '-', starting and ending alphanumeric); bypass via upgradeCompatibility v1.15 or earlier, strictly enforced from v1.17.
